title: ISTQB Certified Tester Foundation Level syllabus v4.0.1
role: Teaching backbone for testing fundamentals, lifecycle, levels and types, static testing, design techniques, risk, defects and tools.

title: ISO/IEC/IEEE 29119-1:2022 — Software testing — General concepts
role: General testing concepts and the common conceptual foundation for the 29119 series.

title: ISO/IEC/IEEE 29119-2:2021 — Software testing — Test processes
role: Governance, management and implementation processes for software testing across lifecycle models.

title: ISO/IEC/IEEE 29119-3:2021 — Software testing — Test documentation
role: Reference model for useful testing work products and documentation outputs.

title: ISO/IEC/IEEE 29119-4:2021 — Software testing — Test techniques
role: Authoritative catalogue and framing of test design techniques.

title: ISO/IEC 25010:2023 — Product quality model
role: Current nine-characteristic product quality model used to reason about quality requirements, testing objectives and acceptance criteria.

title: ISO 9000:2026 — Quality management — Fundamentals and vocabulary
role: Current quality-management fundamentals and vocabulary; used to keep QA/QC/quality concepts broader than software testing alone.

title: IEEE 1012-2024 — System, Software, and Hardware Verification and Validation
role: Verification and validation concepts, intended use, conformance and the range of V&V activities.

title: ISO/IEC/IEEE 29148:2018 — Requirements engineering
role: Current published requirements-engineering reference for testability, quality and traceable requirement information; Edition 3 is in development.

title: ISO/IEC 20246:2017 — Work product reviews
role: Generic framework for reviewing requirements, designs, testware, code and other work products.

title: ISO/IEC/IEEE 16085:2021 — Risk management
role: Systems/software risk-management framework used to ground risk-based testing and prioritization.

title: ISO/IEC TR 29119-6:2021 — Testing in agile projects
role: Guidance for applying the 29119 testing concepts and processes in agile lifecycles.

title: Guide to the Software Engineering Body of Knowledge (SWEBOK) v4.0a
role: Independent completeness check across software testing, requirements, quality and software engineering practice.

title: Manifesto for Agile Software Development and its principles
role: Primary source for Agile values and principles; used to avoid confusing Agile with a specific framework.

title: The Scrum Guide — November 2020
role: Current official Scrum definition used only for Scrum-specific context inside modern delivery.
